# Incident report: Lab results channel disabled, queue backing up
Mode: ai; research: ok
_Simulation with synthetic data. Not a medical device and not clinical advice._

## Impact at detection
ehr_db=healthy, interface_engine=degraded, pacs_storage=healthy, monitor_gw=healthy, lis=healthy, pacs=healthy, ehr=healthy, pharmacy=healthy
Clinical impact score 6.0:
- interface_engine degraded: orders and results are not flowing between systems

## Likely root cause
**interface_engine / bad_config** (confidence 0.70): The interface engine's channel was deliberately disabled, preventing message consumption and causing HL7 backlog.
Evidence: L2, L5

## External research (Tavily, quotes verified against retrieved text)
- H2 supports: Queue depth indicates backlog when processing capacity is exceeded [HL7 Interface Engine for Hospitals and Vendors | Qvera](https://www.qvera.com/hl7-interface-engine)

## Alternatives considered
- `revert_config(interface_engine, key=channel_enabled)`: resolves in simulation
- `restart_service(interface_engine)`: blocked: no_collateral_outage
- `purge_queue(interface_engine)`: blocked: action_kind_permitted
- `enable_downtime_procedure(ehr)`: does not resolve

## Action and verified result
- Executed `revert_config(interface_engine, key=channel_enabled)`. Prediction matched observation: True. Observed recovered: True.

**Outcome: RECOVERED (verified from simulator state)** in 1 tick(s), 0 unnecessary remediation(s).

sources.title: HL7 Interface Engine for Hospitals and Vendors | Qvera
sources.content:
An interface in QIE is a channel. A channel has a source that receives or fetches messages, one or more destinations that deliver them, and a chain of nodes between the two that filter, map and transform. You assemble the channel visually, test it against real messages, and watch it run from the same screen. Nothing about its structure is hidden in configuration files. [...] A change is tested against saved messages before it is promoted, and the global system status page shows every channel, its state and its queue depth on one screen, so the person on call sees a stalled interface before the department does.

sources.title: What is HL7? Messages, Format & Interoperability - Lifepoint Informatics
sources.content:
HL7 files contain multiple messages. They’re organized for batch processing. A hospital might generate hundreds of patient admission messages daily. These messages get bundled into a single HL7 file. The file transfers to another system. The receiving system processes all messages at once.

Text-based format makes this practical. Files open in any text editor. Humans can read them. Programmers can debug them. Issues get spotted quickly. Fixes happen fast.

sources.title: HL7 Messages | Rhapsody
sources.content:
Watch today

The HL7 message type defines the purpose for the message being sent and is present in every HL7 message. Message types are identified by a three-character code and are used in conjunction with a trigger event. An HL7 trigger event is a real-world event that initiates communication and the sending of a message and is shown as part of the message type. Both the message type and trigger event are found in the MSH-9 field of the message. [...] For example, the MSH-9 field might contain the value ADT-A01. This means that ADT is the HL7 message type, and A01 is the trigger event. In the HL7 Standard, an ADT-A01 message is known as a “patient admit” message.

findings.claim: Queue depth indicates backlog when processing capacity is exceeded
findings.quote: global system status page shows every channel, its state and its queue depth

assumptions: The config change was intentional and not reverted
No other factor is preventing message consumption
verdicts.alternative: The channel was disabled by an automated safety mechanism due to an unrelated error
verdicts.would_refute: If channel_enabled were True and the queue continued to grow at the same rate
verdicts.challenge: The config change directly correlates with the backlog, but the inbound message rate might have caused a backlog even with the channel enabled.

assumptions: Inbound HL7 message rate exceeds processing capacity when channel is enabled
The observed queue growth rate would persist with channel enabled
verdicts.alternative: Queue growth is entirely due to the channel being disabled, not due to processing capacity limits
verdicts.would_refute: If channel were enabled and queue depth stabilized or decreased
verdicts.challenge: Research supports that queue depth indicates backlog when capacity is exceeded, but the channel being disabled confounds the observation.

assumptions: Downstream consumer services (EHR, LIS) have an unseen failure preventing them from draining the queue
verdicts.alternative: Consumers are not draining because the channel is disabled, as explicitly stated in L5
verdicts.would_refute: If downstream services are verified healthy and the channel is enabled but the queue still does not drain
verdicts.challenge: The log explicitly attributes the lack of draining to channel_enabled=False, not to downstream service failures.
